inference_rule: eval frozen native static encoder on exact real nodes; early node fusion; original four-layer instance processor, two joint layers, score MLP/pair differences/maximin; stable ascending-global-solver-ID ties; TSP/ATSP raw-only; no calibration
synchronization: perf_counter wall clock; synchronize device before/after each call
native_donor_scope: unmodified donor wrapper including validation/packing and FP32 encoder; no FP16 cast
selector_scope: unmodified selector with resident FP16 nodes freshly encoded online, no disk donor cache
total_scope: unmodified model(raw), forcing donor execution and original FP16 quantization every call
overhead: two integer forward-hook counters included; assertions/validation excluded
excludes: Excludes dataset/checkpoint I/O, hashing, parsing/collation, FP64 local-geometry preparation, CPU-to-GPU transfer, warmup and post-timing validation. No solver decoder or full-system/I/O-inclusive end-to-end latency.
